brand_identity.name: MietGate.de
brand_identity.description: A premium, trustworthy, GDPR-compliant multi-tenant SaaS for the German real-estate rental market. It avoids the 'outdated real estate portal' look, opting for 'Linear-style calm density'—professional, simple, and high-performance.

headings.usage: H1 to H4. Used to deliver a highly sophisticated, high-end European feel. NO Inter for headings.

body.usage: Paragraphs, labels, and forms. Legible, technical, and trustworthy.

mono.usage: Property IDs (e.g., 8KX2A1), matching scores (87/100), financial figures, pricing tables, and technical metadata.

colors.strategy: Trustworthy 'Fintech/Real-Estate' feel. High contrast, low saturation. Easily re-brandable via CSS variables.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp borders (Grid Borders technical look) across dashboards to expose the skeleton and maximize density.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalistic. Use shadow-sm for cards. For high-conversion elements like pricing, use an ambient glow or layered shadow.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used strictly for sticky headers on the marketing site (Crystal Glass variant: high blur backdrop-blur-xl, subtle white/20 border). Flat surfaces only for dashboards to prevent data refraction.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for high-end duotone feel on marketing, and solid/regular on dashboard.

marketing_page.strategy: The 'Tetris' Grid. Asymmetrical, high tension. Generous spacing (p-12, p-24).
sections: Hero: Deep Prussian Blue overlay on architecture image (max bg-black/40). Large Cabinet Grotesk typography.
Benefits: Bento grid layout with overlapping elements.
Pricing: 3 tiers (Starter, Plus, Makler) with 'Tracing Beam' highlight on the middle tier.
Footer: Massive space (py-20), clear legal links (Impressum, Datenschutz, AGB).

dashboard_shell.strategy: High Density Grid (Linear style). Calm density, progressive disclosure. Every pixel utilized.
dashboard_shell.navigation: Collapsible left sidebar (240px default), dark-first or highly contrasted neutral. Main content area has a minimalist top bar (breadcrumb + user profile).
dashboard_shell.kanban_pipeline: Horizontal flex container with overflow-x-auto. Fixed width columns (min-w-[320px]). Cards use 1px borders, minimal shadow, dense information (Matching Score badge, SCHUFA tag).

grids.dashboard_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6. Summary metrics span 1 col, main charts span 2-3.
grids.spacing_scale: Use Tailwind defaults but apply generously on marketing (gap-8 to gap-16) and tightly on dashboard (gap-4).

component_rules.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. On hover: -translate-y-1, shadow-md, border darkens.
component_rules.buttons: Slightly rounded (rounded-md). Solid primary color. On hover: scale slightly or reveal an icon. Never generic.
component_rules.inputs_forms: Shadcn components, lightly customized to feel sharp. 1px border. Focus state must use ring-2 ring-primary offset-2.
component_rules.badges: Used for matching scores (e.g., 87/100). High contrast. e.g., bg-green-100 text-green-900 (light mode).

motion.strategy: Micro-interactions for feedback. Staggered entrances for dashboard lists/kanban cards.
motion.transitions: Specific properties only (e.g., transition-transform duration-200, transition-colors). NO transition-all.
motion.libraries: framer-motion for marketing page scroll effects (fade up, parallax). react-beautiful-dnd or @hello-pangea/dnd for Kanban.

accessibility.contrast: APCA preferred. Standard WCAG AA compliance required. Focus states must have higher contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='kanban-column-neu').
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap complex animations with prefers-reduced-motion checks.

images.description: Contemporary apartment buildings in Berlin. Perfect for the hero section background to establish the German real-estate context.
Modern bright apartment interior. Use in the feature sections (e.g., 'Digitize rental applications').
Two men in a professional setting. Ideal for the 'Target Groups' (Makler/Hausverwaltungen) section or testimonials.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this complete JSON to establish the theme variables before generating components.
The app has two distinct worlds: A highly creative, generously spaced Marketing Page (use pure Tailwind + framer-motion) and a Dense, Linear-style Dashboard (use Shadcn + tight grids).
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Always use Shadcn DropdownMenu, Select, and Calendar.
For the Kanban pipeline, create horizontal scrolling lanes. Use strict 1px borders and distinct card styling.
Use German language for all placeholder text, navigation, and mock data (e.g., 'Neu', 'Prüfung', 'Zusage').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply 'transition: all'. It breaks framer-motion transforms. Specify transition properties.
Never center-align the main app container globally.
Do not use generic blue gradients. Stick to the premium Slate/Prussian Blue solid brand identity.
Ensure all buttons and links have distinct hover states (lighter/darker hue, not opacity).
Always use the defined image URLs. Never use placeholder services like via.placeholder.com.
Add data-testid attributes to all critical interactive elements.
